meta.objective: Launch the remaining locked headline conditions after the baseline cohort: cross-provider abstention and Gilardi l2_neutralized, using the hardened tag policy and the same monitored promotion/prune loop.

decisions.statement: Treat missing semantic-view coverage as a launch precondition, not a live-run failure. Generate the required Gilardi l2 views before launching the semantic cohort.

Promote parser robustness as part of the launch contract after Claude Sonnet 4 emitted a prose-leading freeform label response that the original parser rejected. Patch the parser and rerun the affected experiment before closing the run.
Accept slower Qwen throughput as normal provider latency when the queue remains healthy and pending work continues to drain without failed requests.
